children.alt-text: Panchariya Seva Desk — Shrimad Bhagavat Katha 2026

children.text:
🙏 Jay Shri Krishna,
Shrimad Bhagavad Katha 2026 mein aapka hardik swagat hai.
Yeh Panchariya Seva Desk aapki suvidha aur sahayata ke liye tayyar hai.

Agar aapko paani, bhojan, safai, medical ya kisi bhi prakaar ki madad chahiye ho, toh yahan se aasani se apni request bhej sakte hain.

Humari seva team aap tak jaldi se jaldi pahunchne ka poora prayas karegi.
Aapko kis prakaar ki sahayata chahiye?
